in_sanskrit.name: मैत्रेयी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has a large number of friends

in_marathi.name: Maitreyi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maitreyi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maitreyi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘maitra’ which means friend. The name signifies a friendly, amiable, and compassionate nature. It is believed that the name Maitreyi was given to the beloved wife of the sage Yajnavalkya in Hindu mythology.
